I'm originally from China. Before MDS, I spent 7 years working in Fintech data analysis across the US and China. I've grown especially interested in statistical inference and AI model reasoning — understanding why models make predictions, not just what they predict. I'm here to build a stronger foundation and stay at the frontier of the field.
